SELECT 'COCD' AS type, CASE WHEN B IS NULL THEN CONCAT( '+(${userCoCd}:(', A, ') ${userIpCoCd}:(', A, ') ) ') WHEN A IS NULL THEN CONCAT('+', B) ELSE CONCAT( '+(${userCoCd}:(', A, ') ${userIpCoCd}:(', A, ') ', B, ')') END query, C AS cnt FROM ( SELECT ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT COCD SEPARATOR ' ' ) FROM UI_ADMIN_CO WHERE COCD != 'C00-00' AND ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' ) AS A, ( SELECT '(+${userCoCd}:(C00-00) +${userIpCoCd}:(C00-00))' FROM UI_ADMIN_CO WHERE COCD = 'C00-00' AND ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' ) AS B, ( SELECT COUNT(COCD) FROM UI_ADMIN_CO WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' ) AS C ) AS R UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSICD' AS type, CASE WHEN B IS NULL THEN CONCAT( '+(${userBusiCd}:(', A, ') ${userIpBusiCd}:(', A, ') ) ') WHEN A IS NULL THEN CONCAT('+', B) ELSE CONCAT( '+(${userBusiCd}:(', A, ') ${userIpBusiCd}:(', A, ') ', B, ')') END query, C AS cnt FROM ( SELECT ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT BUSICD SEPARATOR ' ' ) FROM UI_ADMIN_BUSI WHERE BUSICD != 'C00-00' AND ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' ) AS A, ( SELECT '(+${userBusiCd}:(C00-00) +${userIpBusiCd}:(C00-00))' FROM UI_ADMIN_BUSI WHERE BUSICD = 'C00-00' AND ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' ) AS B, ( SELECT COUNT(BUSICD) FROM UI_ADMIN_BUSI WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' ) AS C ) AS R UNION ALL
SELECT 'COCD' AS type, CONCAT( '${userCoCd}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT COCD SEPARATOR ' ' ), ')') AS query, COUNT(COCD) AS cnt FROM UI_ADMIN_CO WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSICD' AS type, CONCAT( '+${userBusiCd}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT BUSICD SEPARATOR ' ' ), ')') AS query, COUNT(BUSICD) AS cnt FROM UI_ADMIN_BUSI WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' UNION ALL
SELECT 'COCD' AS type, CONCAT( '+${userIpCoCd}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT COCD SEPARATOR ' ' ), ')') AS query, COUNT(COCD) AS cnt FROM UI_ADMIN_CO WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSICD' AS type, CONCAT( '+${userIpBusiCd}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT BUSICD SEPARATOR ' ' ), ')') AS query, COUNT(BUSICD) AS cnt FROM UI_ADMIN_BUSI WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' UNION ALL
SELECT 'SERVICE' AS type, CASE WHEN (CONCAT( '+${svc12}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT SERVICECD SEPARATOR ' ' ), ')') != null) THEN CONCAT( '+${svc12}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT SERVICECD SEPARATOR ' ' ), ')') ELSE +${svc12}:'' AS query, COUNT(SERVICECD) AS cnt FROM UI_ADMIN_SERVICE WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' UNION ALL SELECT 'SERVICE' AS type, CONCAT( '-${svc}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT SERVICECD SEPARATOR ' ' ), ')') AS query, COUNT(SERVICECD) AS cnt FROM UI_SERVICE WHERE USE_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT 'REGEXP' AS type, CONCAT( '+${pi}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CODE SEPARATOR ' ' ), ')') AS query, COUNT(CODE) AS cnt FROM UI_ADMIN_REGEXP WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}' UNION ALL SELECT 'USERID' AS type, CONCAT('+${userId}:(', GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT B.USER_ID SEPARATOR ' '),')') AS query, COUNT(B.GROUP_CODE) AS cnt FROM UI_ADMIN_CEO_GROUP A LEFT JOIN UI_USER_GROUP_LIST B ON A.GROUP_CODE=B.GROUP_CODE WHERE ADMIN_ID = '${adminId}'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_ADMIN_CO (ADMIN_ID, COCD ) SELECT #{adminId}, COCD FROM UI_CO WHERE FIND_IN_SET(COCD, REPLACE(#{coCd}, '|', ','))
INSERT INTO UI_ADMIN_BUSI (ADMIN_ID, BUSICD, SORT) SELECT #{adminId}, B.BUSICD, 0 FROM UI_CO A, UI_BUSI B WHERE A.COCD = B.COCD AND FIND_IN_SET(B.BUSICD, REPLACE(#{busiCd}, '|', ','))
INSERT INTO UI_ADMIN_DEPT (ADMIN_ID, DEPTCD, SORT) SELECT #{adminId}, B.DEPTCD, 0 FROM UI_CO A, UI_DEPT B WHERE A.COCD = B.COCD AND FIND_IN_SET(B.DEPTCD, REPLACE(#{deptCd}, '|', ','))

INSERT INTO UI_ADMIN_SERVICE (ADMIN_ID, SERVICECD) SELECT #{adminId}, SERVICECD FROM ( SELECT LEFT(SERVICECD, 3) AS SERVICECD FROM UI_SERVICE GROUP BY LEFT(SERVICECD, 3) UNION SELECT LEFT(SERVICECD, 4) AS SERVICECD FROM UI_SERVICE WHERE SERVICECD = 'EMMA' UNION SELECT LEFT(SERVICECD, 5) AS SERVICECD FROM UI_SERVICE WHERE SERVICECD = 'EMMAX' ) AS RS WHERE FIND_IN_SET(SERVICECD, REPLACE(#{service}, '|', ','))
INSERT INTO UI_ADMIN_CEO_GROUP (ADMIN_ID, GROUP_CODE) SELECT #{adminId}, GROUP_CODE FROM UI_USER_GROUP WHERE FIND_IN_SET(GROUP_CODE, REPLACE(#{readAuth}, '|', ','))
INSERT INTO UI_ADMIN_REGEXP (ADMIN_ID, CODE) SELECT #{adminId}, CODE FROM UI_REGEXP WHERE FIND_IN_SET(CODE, REPLACE(#{regexp}, '|', ','))
